violation_type.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §744.3203)
violation_type.short_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment
violation_type.typical_finding: It was found during the inspection the operation had a Jungle gym and air plane equipment you climb and there was not 6 feet of cleared space around the primeter of the equipment and use zones for the equipment were overlapping.

finding_variants.text: It was found during the inspection the operation had a Jungle gym and air plane equipment you climb and there was not 6 feet of cleared space around the primeter of the equipment and use zones for the equipment were overlapping.
Proper use zones around equipment is not being utilized.
